note: Moderate-quality documents: readable and plausible, each with obvious problems at three depths. Low: mechanical (typos, agreement, doubled words, comma splices). Medium: sentence-level (wordiness, passive voice that hides who acts, inconsistent terms, ambiguous pronouns, unsupported superlatives). High: document-level (contradictions between sections, a buried main point or request, a missing prerequisite or definition, steps out of order). A review that only fixes typos finds the lows and misses what matters.

team-status-update.md.issue: Subject-verb agreement: "two of them still need".

team-status-update.md.quote: Ravi finished the the load tests
We recieve the new hardware quote on Thursday.
team-status-update.md.issue: Misspelling ("recieve"); it is also in the present tense for a future event.

team-status-update.md.quote: At this point in time, due to the fact that the index is very large
team-status-update.md.issue: Wordy, filler-heavy sentence that says only that the large index will take long to copy.

team-status-update.md.quote: It will be decided later who handles the rollback.
team-status-update.md.issue: Passive and vague: the biggest risk has no owner or decision date.

team-status-update.md.quote: Kim will finish the alert pipeline move by Wednesday.
team-status-update.md.issue: "Alert pipeline" appears to mean the "notification queue" named earlier; the two names for one thing confuse the reader.

team-status-update.md.quote: We are still on track to finish the migration by Friday, May 16.

team-status-update.md.quote: we need a decision from the leadership team by Tuesday

printer-setup-guide.md.quote: Your laptop will search the network, this can take up to a minute.
printer-setup-guide.md.issue: Comma splice: two sentences joined by a comma.

printer-setup-guide.md.quote: make sure your connected to the office Wi-Fi
the duplex functionality of the device may be constrained in certain circumstances, such as when utilizing heavier paper stock
printer-setup-guide.md.issue: Jargon and wordiness for a simple point: two-sided printing may not work with heavy paper.

printer-setup-guide.md.issue: Passive and unhelpful in a how-to: it does not say who cancels it or where the queue is.

printer-setup-guide.md.quote: You need your staff login and about ten minutes.

printer-setup-guide.md.quote: Install the driver package from the IT portal.
printer-setup-guide.md.issue: This step is last but must come before step 3: the guide itself says Heron will not appear until the driver is installed.
Contradicts the troubleshooting section, which sends printer problems to the help desk at extension 4410.

remote-work-policy.md.quote: Requests are submitted through the HR portal or by email or by talking to your manager or in the weekly team meeting.
remote-work-policy.md.issue: A run-on list of four channels leaves the actual process unclear; a policy should name one way to request.
A requirement with no standard: "reliable" is not defined.
